title: Real‑World ML Applications 🌍
description: Discover how ML powers recommendations, voice assistants, medical diagnosis, and more.

slides.title: ML in Your Pocket 📱
slides.content:
# Everyday Machine Learning

You interact with ML dozens of times a day without realising it:
- **Recommendations**: Netflix suggests shows, Amazon recommends products.
- **Voice Assistants**: Siri, Alexa, and Google understand your speech.
- **Face Recognition**: Unlocking your phone with your face.
- **Spam Filters**: Keeping your inbox clean.

quizData.question: Which of these is NOT a typical ML application?
quizData.explanation: A calculator follows fixed arithmetic rules; it doesn’t learn from data.

slides.title: Healthcare & Science 🧬
slides.content:
# ML Saves Lives

- **Medical Imaging**: Detecting tumours in X‑rays and MRIs.
- **Drug Discovery**: Predicting molecule interactions to speed up research.
- **Genomics**: Analysing DNA sequences for disease risk.

These systems learn from thousands of labelled medical records and images.

slides.title: Finance & Business 💰
slides.content:
# Smart Money Decisions

- **Fraud Detection**: Spotting unusual credit card transactions.
- **Credit Scoring**: Assessing loan eligibility.
- **Stock Trading**: Algorithmic trading using predictive models.
- **Customer Churn**: Predicting which customers might leave a service.

quizData.question: A spam filter is an example of supervised learning because it is trained on emails labeled as 'spam' or 'not spam'.
quizData.explanation: Yes! Spam filters typically use supervised learning with labelled email data.

slides.title: Your Turn 💡
slides.content:
## Become an ML Detective
Pick any app on your phone and think: where could machine learning be hiding? Social media feeds, photo tagging, keyboard suggestions — almost everything uses it!
